reference_sql:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines that holds a copy
  SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur,
         MIN(order_line_id) AS original_line_id
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT ol.order_line_id,
       ls.original_line_id,
       s.store_code,
       ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS copy_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN line_sets AS ls
  ON ls.order_id = ol.order_id
 AND ls.product_id = ol.product_id
 AND ls.quantity = ol.quantity
 AND ls.unit_price_eur = ol.unit_price_eur
 AND (ls.promo_id = ol.promo_id OR (ls.promo_id IS NULL AND ol.promo_id IS NULL))
 AND ls.line_discount_eur = ol.line_discount_eur
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE ol.order_line_id > ls.original_line_id
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id

SELECT ol.order_line_id,
       ls.original_line_id,
       s.store_code,
       ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS copy_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN (
  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, COALESCE(promo_id, -1) AS promo_key, line_discount_eur,
         MIN(order_line_id) AS original_line_id
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, COALESCE(promo_id, -1), line_discount_eur
) AS ls
  ON ls.order_id = ol.order_id
 AND ls.product_id = ol.product_id
 AND ls.quantity = ol.quantity
 AND ls.unit_price_eur = ol.unit_price_eur
 AND ls.promo_key = COALESCE(ol.promo_id, -1)
 AND ls.line_discount_eur = ol.line_discount_eur
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE ol.order_line_id > ls.original_line_id
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id

SELECT ol.order_line_id,
       MIN(f.order_line_id) AS original_line_id,
       s.store_code,
       ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS copy_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN order_lines AS f
  ON f.order_id = ol.order_id
 AND f.product_id = ol.product_id
 AND f.quantity = ol.quantity
 AND f.unit_price_eur = ol.unit_price_eur
 AND f.promo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ol.promo_id
 AND f.line_discount_eur = ol.line_discount_eur
 AND f.order_line_id < ol.order_line_id
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY ol.order_line_id, s.store_code, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id

SELECT ol.order_line_id,
       (SELECT MIN(f.order_line_id)
        FROM order_lines AS f
        WHERE f.order_id = ol.order_id
          AND f.product_id = ol.product_id
          AND f.quantity = ol.quantity
          AND f.unit_price_eur = ol.unit_price_eur
          AND f.promo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ol.promo_id
          AND f.line_discount_eur = ol.line_discount_eur) AS original_line_id,
       s.store_code,
       ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS copy_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1
              FROM order_lines AS e
              WHERE e.order_id = ol.order_id
                AND e.product_id = ol.product_id
                AND e.quantity = ol.quantity
                AND e.unit_price_eur = ol.unit_price_eur
                AND e.promo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ol.promo_id
                AND e.line_discount_eur = ol.line_discount_eur
                AND e.order_line_id < ol.order_line_id)
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id

 AND f.line_discount_eur = ol.line_discount_eur
 AND f.order_line_id < ol.order_line_id
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id

GROUP BY ol.order_line_id, s.store_code, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur

other_way.tradeoff: A self-join finds each copy's earlier twin directly, but it needs a GROUP BY to keep one row per copy.

solver.query:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, MIN(order_line_id) AS orig
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT l.order_line_id, g.orig AS original_line_id, s.store_code,
       l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur AS copy_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines l
JOIN g ON g.order_id = l.order_id AND g.product_id = l.product_id AND g.quantity = l.quantity
  AND g.unit_price_eur = l.unit_price_eur AND g.promo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.promo_id
  AND g.line_discount_eur = l.line_discount_eur
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE l.order_line_id > g.orig
ORDER BY l.order_line_id
